usedFor: quickemailverification checks whether an address is valid and deliverable with “Verify Email Address”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created” in TickTick, then “Verify Email Address” in quickemailverification
bestTemplate.why: A new task that holds an address can be checked before anyone writes to it.

watchOut: It checks one thing, so decide in your automation what happens when an address fails.
